zh-CN.summary: 应用 Pod 以非 root 身份运行，镜像只读，没有 API 令牌。使用 TLS 和认证的 Percona MongoDB Pod 保持受限配置，只有一个例外：根文件系统可写入，因为 TLS 文件写死放在 /tmp。CloudNativePG 使用 operator 管理、权限受限的令牌。MongoDB 要求客户端证书。LibreChat 会出示集群 CA 签发、有效期 90 天的客户端证书，由 cert-manager 负责更新，证书一换，LibreChat 就会重启。

zh-TW.summary: 應用程式 Pod 以非 root 身分執行，映像檔唯讀，沒有 API 權杖。使用 TLS 和驗證的 Percona MongoDB Pod 維持受限設定，只有一個例外：根檔案系統可寫入，因為 TLS 檔案寫死放在 /tmp。CloudNativePG 使用 operator 管理、權限受限的權杖。MongoDB 要求用戶端憑證。LibreChat 會出示叢集 CA 簽發、有效期 90 天的用戶端憑證，由 cert-manager 負責更新，憑證一換，LibreChat 就會重新啟動。

zh-CN.mitigation: 只有 operator 管理的 Pod 拿到这个明确的例外：readOnlyRootFilesystem=false。它们仍然强制使用 TLS，以 UID 1001 运行，去掉所有额外权限，不允许提升权限，并使用 RuntimeDefault。所有普通应用的镜像都保持只读。协调完成后不会再改动任何东西，TLS 也不会被关掉。
zh-CN.risk: Percona v1.23.1 的启动脚本，会把 TLS 文件写到写死的路径 /tmp/tls.pem 和 /tmp/tls-internal.pem。自定义资源也没办法为主容器单独挂载 /tmp。

zh-TW.mitigation: 只有 operator 管理的 Pod 拿到這個明確的例外：readOnlyRootFilesystem=false。它們仍然強制使用 TLS，以 UID 1001 執行，拿掉所有額外權限，不允許提升權限，並使用 RuntimeDefault。所有一般應用程式的映像檔都維持唯讀。協調完成後不會再改動任何東西，TLS 也不會被關掉。
zh-TW.risk: Percona v1.23.1 的啟動腳本，會把 TLS 檔案寫到寫死的路徑 /tmp/tls.pem 和 /tmp/tls-internal.pem。自訂資源也沒辦法替主容器另外掛載 /tmp。

risks.mitigation: Only the operator-managed pods get this explicit exception, readOnlyRootFilesystem=false. They still require TLS, run as UID 1001, drop all capabilities, allow no escalation and use RuntimeDefault. All ordinary application images stay read-only. Nothing is changed after reconcile, and TLS is never turned off.
risks.risk: The Percona v1.23.1 entry scripts write TLS files to the hardcoded paths /tmp/tls.pem and /tmp/tls-internal.pem. The custom resource has no way to mount /tmp separately in the main container.

zh-CN.mitigation: 部署时必须明确确认这份许可。Mongo 服务是私有的，只有应用能访问。operator 的 Apache-2.0 许可只涵盖 operator 本身。Meilisearch 使用 MIT 许可的社区版镜像，不含 BUSL 许可的企业版模块。
zh-CN.risk: MongoDB 服务器采用 SSPL-1.0 许可，把 MongoDB 作为服务提供给别人时，要承担额外义务。SSPL 并未通过 OSI 认可。

zh-TW.mitigation: 部署時必須明確確認這份授權。Mongo 服務是私有的，只有應用程式連得到。operator 的 Apache-2.0 授權只涵蓋 operator 本身。Meilisearch 使用 MIT 授權的社群版映像檔，不含 BUSL 授權的企業版模組。
zh-TW.risk: MongoDB 伺服器採用 SSPL-1.0 授權，把 MongoDB 當成服務提供給別人時，要負擔額外義務。SSPL 並未通過 OSI 認可。

risks.mitigation: You must acknowledge the exact license when you deploy. The Mongo service is private and reachable only by the app. The Apache-2.0 license of the operator covers only the operator. Meilisearch uses the MIT community image, and the BUSL enterprise modules are not included.
risks.risk: The MongoDB server uses the SSPL-1.0 license, which sets duties for anyone who offers MongoDB as a service. SSPL is not OSI-approved.

zh-CN.mitigation: 目录里的 operator 会为每个集群创建服务账号和 RBAC 权限。普通应用 Pod 和 Percona Pod 的令牌都已停用。
zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要 Kubernetes API 凭证。

zh-TW.mitigation: 目錄裡的 operator 會為每個叢集建立服務帳號和 RBAC 權限。一般應用程式 Pod 和 Percona Pod 的權杖都已停用。
zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要 Kubernetes API 認證資訊。

risks.mitigation: The catalog operator creates a service account and RBAC permissions for each cluster. The ordinary app pods and the Percona pods have their tokens turned off.
risks.risk: The CloudNativePG instance manager needs Kubernetes API credentials.

zh-CN.mitigation: Meilisearch 以加固过的单副本 StatefulSet 运行。文件、MongoDB、pgvector、Meilisearch 转储文件和生成的机密，请一起备份。为了让文件备份一致，备份时要先停掉写入的程序。请在独立的命名空间测试完整恢复，并检查登录、已保存的凭证、搜索和文档检索是否正常。
zh-CN.risk: Meilisearch 在目录里没有 operator。本地文件和各个数据库的恢复时间点也各不相同。

zh-TW.mitigation: Meilisearch 以加固過的單副本 StatefulSet 執行。檔案、MongoDB、pgvector、Meilisearch 傾印檔和產生的機密，請一起備份。為了讓檔案備份一致，備份時要先停掉寫入的程式。請在獨立的命名空間測試完整還原，並檢查登入、已儲存的認證資訊、搜尋和文件擷取是否正常。
zh-TW.risk: Meilisearch 在目錄裡沒有 operator。本機檔案和各個資料庫的還原時間點也各不相同。

risks.mitigation: Meilisearch runs as a hardened single-replica StatefulSet. Back up the files, MongoDB, pgvector, Meilisearch dumps and the generated Secrets together. Stop the writers so the file backup is consistent. Test a full restore in an isolated namespace, and check login, saved credentials, search and document retrieval.
risks.risk: Meilisearch has no operator in the catalog. The local files and the databases are also restored from separate points in time.

zh-CN.mitigation: 公开使用之前，请先设置你自己的隐私政策和服务条款。

zh-CN.mitigation: 新内核上 MongoDB 一启动就崩溃时，请确认 Percona Pod 带有 GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1。
zh-CN.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 在 Linux 内核 6.19 以上无法启动（SERVER-121912）。模板设置了 GLIBC_TUNABLES 来绕过，但还没有在真实集群上验证过。

zh-TW.mitigation: 新核心上 MongoDB 一啟動就當掉時，請確認 Percona Pod 有帶 GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1。
zh-TW.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 在 Linux 核心 6.19 以上無法啟動（SERVER-121912）。範本設定了 GLIBC_TUNABLES 來繞過，但還沒有在真實叢集上驗證過。

risks.mitigation: If MongoDB crashes at start on a new kernel, check that the Percona pods carry GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1.
risks.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 does not start on Linux kernel 6.19 or newer (SERVER-121912). The template sets GLIBC_TUNABLES as a workaround, and this has not been verified on a real cluster.

security.summary: The app pods run as non-root with read-only images and no API token. The Percona MongoDB pods use TLS and authentication and stay restricted, with one exception: a writable root filesystem for TLS files that are hardcoded to /tmp. CloudNativePG uses limited tokens that the operator manages. MongoDB requires client certificates. LibreChat presents a 90-day client certificate from the cluster CA, cert-manager renews it, and LibreChat restarts when it changes.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: librechat-config
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
data:
  start.cjs: |
    const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
    const path = require('node:path');
    process.chdir('/app');
    process.env.CREDS_KEY = Buffer.from(process.env.CREDS_KEY_SEED, 'base64url').toString('hex');
    process.env.CREDS_IV = Buffer.from(process.env.CREDS_IV_SEED, 'base64url').subarray(0, 16).toString('hex');
    process.env.MONGO_URI = `mongodb://librechat:${encodeURIComponent(process.env.MONGO_PASSWORD)}@mongodb-rs0-0.mongodb-rs0.{{ .Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local:27017/LibreChat?authSource=admin&replicaSet=rs0&tls=true&tlsCAFile=/mongo-tls/ca.crt&tlsCertificateKeyFile=/mongo-client/client.pem`;
    if (process.argv[2] === 'init') {
      for (const name of ['data', 'uploads', 'logs', 'images', 'skill']) require('node:fs').mkdirSync('/persistent/' + name, {recursive: true});
      // The upstream administrative CLI uses the same registration service as the app.
      // Check existence first so a container restart does not reset the account password.
      const mongoose = require('/app/node_modules/mongoose');
      (async () => {
        await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGO_URI, {serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 30000});
        const existing = await mongoose.connection.db.collection('users').findOne({email: process.env.BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL});
        await mongoose.disconnect();
        if (existing) return;
        const child = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['/app/config/create-user.js', process.env.BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL, 'Administrator', 'admin', process.env.BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD, '--email-verified=true'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, cwd: '/app'});
        if (child.error) throw child.error;
        if (child.status !== 0) throw new Error('Upstream account creation failed');
      })().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
    } else {
      // The driver reads the client certificate once. Exit after cert-manager renews it, so that the container restarts with the new one.
      const fs = require('node:fs');
      const loaded = fs.readFileSync('/mongo-client/client.pem');
      setInterval(() => {
        try {
          if (fs.readFileSync('/mongo-client/client.pem').equals(loaded)) return;
        } catch {
          return;
        }
        console.log('MongoDB client certificate renewed; restarting');
        process.exit(0);
      }, 60000).unref();
      require('/app/api/server/index.js');
    }

    cache: true

    '

kind: Certificate

  name: librechat-mongodb-client
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  secretName: librechat-mongodb-client
  commonName: librechat
  duration: 2160h
  renewBefore: 720h
  usages:
  - client auth
  privateKey:
    algorithm: ECDSA
    size: 256
    rotationPolicy: Always
  additionalOutputFormats:
  - type: CombinedPEM
  issuerRef:
    group: cert-manager.io
    kind: Issuer
    name: mongodb-psmdb-issuer

metadata:
  name: rag-api
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rag-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: librechat
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rag-api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: rag-api
        image: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat-rag-api-dev-lite:latest@sha256:a62ce2221b43a9bb57fa6cb733e7047c80132960272c33d5704028f3071a1251
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8000
        env:
        - name: HOME
          value: /tmp
        - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
          value: '1'
        - name: RAG_HOST
          value: 0.0.0.0
        - name: RAG_PORT
          value: '8000'
        - name: DB_HOST
          value: rag-db-rw
        - name: DB_PORT
          value: '5432'
        - name: POSTGRES_DB
          value: rag
        - name: POSTGRES_USER
          value: app
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: rag-db-app
              key: password
        - name: PGVECTOR_CREATE_EXTENSION
          value: 'false'
        - name: PGSSLMODE
          value: verify-full
        - name: OPENAI_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: '{{ .Inputs.providerSecret }}'
              key: OPENAI_API_KEY
        - name: RAG_UPLOAD_DIR
          value: /tmp/uploads
        - name: SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS
          value: 'true'
        - name: PGSSLROOTCERT
          value: /pg-tls/ca.crt
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: pg-tls
          mountPath: /pg-tls
          readOnly: true
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      - name: pg-tls
        secret:
          secretName: rag-db-ca
          items:
          - key: ca.crt
            path: ca.crt
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: meilisearch
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: meilisearch
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: meilisearch
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: librechat
        app.kubernetes.io/name: meilisearch
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: meilisearch
        image: docker.io/getmeili/meilisearch:v1.56.2@sha256:9600db22be3fcbf3d506176d3a73dd70a65c5719d9aa1d2837355b75afb8f4fb
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 7700
        env:
        - name: MEILI_MASTER_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: meili-key
        - name: MEILI_ENV
          value: production
        - name: MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS
          value: 'true'
        - name: MEILI_UPGRADE_DB
          value: 'true'
        - name: HOME
          value: /meili_data
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /meili_data
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: data
    spec:
      accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: rag-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: librechat
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:17-standard-trixie@sha256:ed6923f9ba2399cf9070379a353c710c29ced8a294be73986a2c3dae7e599ce3
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: rag
      owner: app
      encoding: UTF8
      postInitApplicationSQL:
      - CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '2'
      memory: 2Gi
---
apiVersion: psmdb.percona.com/v1
kind: PerconaServerMongoDB
metadata:
  name: mongodb
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  crVersion: 1.23.1
  unsafeFlags:
    replsetSize: true
  image: docker.io/percona/percona-server-mongodb:8.0.32-14@sha256:5ba5f240d2dc98bc6236ab1d79c0862c4b62dba9d98cd0ffdf716c30473d2d11
  initImage: docker.io/percona/percona-server-mongodb-operator:1.23.1@sha256:78c87b933e184b9af36dbb0078751862c75934c1521c33d3be4d0a38aa58dd0a
  initContainerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    capabilities: &id001
      drop:
      - ALL
    seccompProfile: &id002
      type: RuntimeDefault
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  updateStrategy: SmartUpdate
  upgradeOptions:
    apply: disabled
    setFCV: false
  tls:
    mode: requireTLS
    allowInvalidCertificates: false
  secrets:
    users: mongodb-system-users
    encryptionKey: mongodb-encryption-key
  sharding:
    enabled: false
  users:
  - name: librechat
    db: admin
    passwordSecretRef:
      name: app-secrets
      key: mongo-password
    roles:
    - name: readWrite
      db: LibreChat
  replsets:
  - name: rs0
    size: 1
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: librechat
    serviceAccountName: mongodb-operand
    # The image sets glibc.pthread.rseq=0, so TCMalloc takes rseq for per-CPU caches.
    # Kernels 6.19 to 7.0.13 break that, and mongod 8.0 then exits at start (SERVER-121912).
    # With rseq kept by glibc, TCMalloc uses per-thread caches and mongod starts.
    env:
    - name: GLIBC_TUNABLES
      value: glibc.pthread.rseq=1
    affinity:
      antiAffinityTopologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
    podSecurityContext:
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 1001
      runAsGroup: 1001
      fsGroup: 1001
      seccompProfile:
        type: RuntimeDefault
    containerSecurityContext: &id003
      runAsNonRoot: true
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
      capabilities: *id001
      seccompProfile: *id002
      runAsUser: 1001
      runAsGroup: 1001
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 250m
        memory: 512Mi
      limits:
        cpu: '2'
        memory: 2Gi
    podDisruptionBudget:
      maxUnavailable: 1
    expose:
      enabled: false
    volumeSpec:
      persistentVolumeClaim:
        accessModes:
        - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi
